profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Technology-driven Software Engineer with 5 years of experience in translating business requirements and functional specification into code modules and software solutions. Highly knowledgeable in frontend and backend languages and architecture to support the configuration, modification, and testing of enterprise application. Drives the adoption of new technologies by researching innovative technology trends.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected a mission-critical package tracking application serving 1,267+ users with 35+ Lambda functions, React frontend, Aurora MySQL, and multi-environment CI/CD across 4 AWS accounts.
Led Amazon Security Review (ASR) achieving BSC4 logging compliance (Grade A-), implemented JWT authentication via Cognito, and established 731-day audit trails for Critical data.
Designed serverless infrastructure using API Gateway, CloudFront CDN, and S3 storage supporting global Project Kuiper logistics operations.
Optimized codebase with Python/Node.js Lambda functions and React.js to maintain high availability for warehouse operations.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon EC2 · Amazon Dynamodb · Amazon CloudWatch · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS Lambda · AWS Command Line Interface (CLI) · Python (Programming Language) · React.js · Amazon SQS · AWS CloudFormation · AWS Identity and Access Management (AWS IAM) · Software Design · AWS Glue

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and built scalable, event-driven microservices for post-checkout payment, refund, and POS using Java 21, Spring Boot, and AWS (Lambda, SQS, DynamoDB), supporting 5M+ monthly transactions with 99.9% uptime.
- Designed and implemented backend architecture to integrate with major payment providers (Worldpay, Vantiv, FISERV, PayPal) and internal fraud detection systems via RESTful APIs, improving system reliability by 30%.
- Migrated legacy services to containerized microservices on EKS, streamlining deployment with GitHub Actions and Terraform.
- Enhanced system monitoring and alerting using Splunk and CloudWatch, significantly reducing incident response times and improving system reliability.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS Lambda · Spring Boot · Amazon Dynamodb · Amazon SQS · Amazon CloudWatch · Amazon S3 · Amazon EC2

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
(contract through MatchPoint Solutions)
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to design and develop multiple services using Java to support new MFA method, resulting in a 95% successful registration rate among employees.
- Oversaw the design and implementation of IAM solutions services, assuring seamless integration with LastPass and OneLogin for 30k internal employees, ensuring compliance with security policies and industry regulations
- Developed internal Java applications to streamline user provisioning and de-provisioning processes, manage user unuse access.
- Provided technical support and troubleshooting for IAM-related issues, ensuring timely issue resolution.
positions.insights: Skills: Security Implementation · Java · Identity & Access Management (IAM) · Full-Stack Development · Front-End Development · Back-End Web Development · React.js · Microsoft Azure · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Software Documentation · Agile Methodologies · Angular

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed, developed and deployed Enterprise electronic monitoring application for government agencies in microservice architecture.
- Built microservice RESTful APIs that served data to the Angular front-end system, which support Google Maps integration for custom zones and client tracking, case management, comprehensive client activity that handled over 500k users.
- Streamlined infrastructure by deploying Docker containers, CI/CD pipeline within Kubernetes, reducing system load by 35%.
- Assisted in requirement analysis, high, low-level design and complex code development for Enterprise System.
positions.insights: Skills: Mean Stack · .NET in Azure · Software Design · Full-Stack Development · Java · JavaScript · Spring Boot · Microsoft Azure · Microsoft SQL Server · System desgin · Agile Methodologies · C# · .NET Core · .NET Framework · ASP.NET · ASP.NET MVC · Angular · RESTful WebServices · React.js · Docker · Kubernetes · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon S3

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed, implemented, and managed large-scale IAM enterprise solutions and Azure cloud-based B2E, B2C, and B2B authentication services. Facilitated adoption by 30+ internal application teams 
- Developed applications that utilize protocols (OAuth 2.0, OpenID, SAML) to bring security to federated identity.
- Developed internal automation system to update employee profile attributes for 20k employees using Azure Graph Api.
- Responsible for front-end, middle-tier implementation and integration with backend databases.
- Influence and communicate with customers from all sections of the enterprise - including end user, technical resources, IT leadership and other business leaders to develop B2E, B2C and B2B Single sign-on (SSO) authentication service using Azure Cloud
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Core · .NET Framework · Angular · Microsoft Azure · React.js · Java · Spring Boot · Azure DevOps Server · XML · SAML 2.0 · OpenID Connect (OIDC) · OAuth · Microsoft SQL Server · SQL

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed HR applications for Capital One, delivering scalable, secure, and high-performance solutions that improved employee experience and streamlined HR operations, handling over 50,000 employee records.
- Create Typescript reusable components and services to consume REST API's using Component based architecture 
- Help migrating legacy system to Sailpoint IIQ at Capital One followed the RBAC framework for Identity Access Management (IAM)
- Reviewed application code, component designs to ensure high quality and meet Business/Functional requirements
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · Spring Framework · TypeScript · Database Design · Front-End Development · Software Development · REST APIs · Agile Methodologies · SQL · Java · Mean Stack · Application Engineering · .NET in Azure · Software Construction · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Enterprise Architecture

positions.title: Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Built a dynamic eCommerce Webapp to sell products online. Increased company sales by 42%.
- Bi-weekly meeting with project manager and end-user to enhance the system. Increased customer satisfaction scores by 25%. 
- Maintain the Application and add new feature to enhance quality and usability the product following principles in Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Software Development · REST APIs · Agile Methodologies · ASP.NET · Front-End Development · .NET Core · Scrum · HTML · Database Design · .NET Framework · SQL

positions.title: ISEP Mentor
positions.description:
- Helped set goals and work toward achieving them by educating six mentees about various resources available on campus, as the need arises
- Served as a positive social and academic role-model by supporting mentees with their involvement on campus

positions.title: Resident Advisor
positions.description:
- Provided educational programs and counseling for a residence hall wing of 50 college students. Responsible for residents’ welfares and advised them on personal and academic issues. 
- Managed administrative tasks including room condition reports, maintenance requests, incident reports, and the room change process. Enforced college policy.

positions.title: Academic Leader
positions.description:
- Established 5 educational programs and workshops per quarter including SAT, ACT, College Fair, Science and Technology Fair
- Communicate (via phone and email) with 50 parents per quarter to ensure their involvement and attention to student’s academic progress and school activities
- Tutor over 250 students per quarter in Math, Chemistry, Physics and American History 
- Facilitated Gear Up Site Coordinator with organizing office, planning events, scheduling and ordering office supplies 
- Designed and executed Student Improvement Plan in accordance with teacher
